title: Matrix Block Sum
summary: For a m x n matrix mat and integer k, compute a new matrix answer where each element answer[i][j] equals the sum of elements within a k x k block centered at (i, j), ensuring the block stays within matrix boundaries.
statement: For a m x n matrix mat and integer k, compute a new matrix answer where each element answer[i][j] equals the sum of elements within a k x k block centered at (i, j), ensuring the block stays within matrix boundaries.
constraints: For each cell sum rows i-k..i+k and columns j-k..j+k clipped to the matrix.
hints: A 2D prefix table answers any clipped rectangle sum in constant time.
Build prefix with one zero border row and column.
For each center, clip its four bounds and apply inclusion-exclusion.
The prefix rectangle formula counts every cell in the block exactly once.
editorial: The prefix rectangle formula counts every cell in the block exactly once.

tests.explanation: Each output is the sum of its clipped 3-by-3 neighborhood.
A zero-radius block returns the original matrix.
